Third-party code bundled in this folder
=======================================

lame.min.js
  Project : lamejs 1.2.1, a JavaScript port of the LAME MP3 encoder
  Source  : https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs (npm: lamejs@1.2.1, file lame.min.js)
  LAME    : https://lame.sourceforge.io/
  License : LGPL (LAME is LGPL 2.1 or later, lamejs package.json says LGPL-3.0)
  SHA-256 : 15d285e2587b3bdbfd18a68de6ce07cc074f7480a82c3815da2dc1c348ec6df4
  Size    : 156043 bytes

The file is the upstream lame.min.js, byte for byte, unmodified. It is kept as a
separate file that the page loads on demand (only when the Export Audio dialog
opens), so it can be swapped for another build of LAME without touching the
rest of the code. The upstream usage note (lamejs-LICENSE.txt) and the LGPL 2.1
text (LGPL-2.1.txt) are shipped next to it.

This studio's MP3 export is encoded by LAME. Thanks to the LAME project.
